title: SO-RSI, first real run
notes: The uncommitted changes recorded in provenance were exactly the opposing-edits fix and runner provenance, committed right after as 98369c7 and b0039d5 (one earlier session with the old detector was discarded). Build: 2 rounds x 4 datasets, budget 6; round 2, with lessons from round 1, had fewer failed experiments (4% vs 17%) and fewer anomalies. Test (2 repeats): no AUC difference beyond noise; memory cut failed experiments (8% vs 12%) and gave the most stable hospital result; 19 of 24 test mismatches were score drops within noise, so few diagnoses could be confirmed. DeepSeek-V3.1 via W&B Inference.
outcome: SO-RSI without memory vs plain Tumble -1.2% (within noise); SO-RSI with memory vs plain Tumble -0.5% (within noise); 11/36 tested diagnoses confirmed (build + test)
